name: Eyes
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of guarding what we allow our eyes to behold, as seen in Psalms 101:3 where the psalmist commits to setting no wicked thing before his eyes. The eyes are a God-given gift, as Proverbs 20:12 affirms, and must be directed rightly to avoid sin, including lustful looks condemned in Matthew 5:28. Pride and haughtiness, reflected in the eyes, are also sinful (Proverbs 21:4), and believers are called to keep their eyes focused on holy things, seeking divine revelation as in Psalms 119:18. The radical call in Matthew 5:29 to remove anything causing spiritual offense underscores the seriousness of what our eyes fixate upon.
